purpose: analysis-only fixed-threshold sensitivity of the provided Overture POI facility component; no target fit, target RMSE, score claim, scored promotion, or upload

scope.row_order: authoritative per-region sample GEOID order; read only GEOID from sample files; no sample score placeholders

category_contract.matching_rule: union of categories.primary and categories.alternate; a POI contributes at most once to each selected family

v0_poi_candidate.role: frozen feature-derived v0 POI output for measure-before comparison; not a target

v2_poi_baseline.role: existing fixed v2 analysis-only prior/composition used as the raw-count baseline; no fitted or score-derived values

provided_category_confidence_sources.purpose: bbox only for spatial assignment; selected categories for family counts; confidence for threshold weights; sources for provenance/missingness diagnostics only

provided_tract_inputs.usage: provided strata supply fixed v2 prior covariates; ur_class is descriptive only

prior_audit.use: category/source/confidence semantics and expected input lineage; not a target

count_and_candidate_rules.raw_family_count: count each provided POI once per exact selected category family matched by primary or any alternate category
count_and_candidate_rules.weighted_family_count: sum confidence for selected-family POIs with valid finite confidence in [0,1] and confidence >= threshold; otherwise contribute zero; each POI counts at most once per family
count_and_candidate_rules.missing_or_invalid_confidence: zero weight for the weighted numerator, retain the raw count, and report missing/invalid counts; do not impute confidence
count_and_candidate_rules.unclassified_category_rows: retain the existing fixed v2 treatment: no-category rows are allocated by the region-level family-share ratios computed from all categorized POIs; keep this allocation identical across raw and threshold variants so the sensitivity isolates weighting of selected categorized POIs
count_and_candidate_rules.sources: report dataset presence/source mix for matched family records; no source-dependent weight or source-defined quality ranking is imposed
count_and_candidate_rules.facility_gap: for each type apply the existing pooled v2 logistic presence prior and expected-miss function to (threshold-weighted selected family count + unchanged v2 unclassified allocation); average the defined fire, EMS, and school type gaps
count_and_candidate_rules.establishments_half: hold the existing provided-feature-only v2 establishments component fixed at preregistered analysis sensitivity k_pop=0.024; do not use removed CBP values
count_and_candidate_rules.poi_gap: equal mean of whichever facility and establishments halves are defined, matching the existing v2 POI composition
count_and_candidate_rules.candidate_defined: the v2 POI definedness flag from the preceding component-composition rule; weighted count equal to zero is observed absence under the fixed presence prior, not an undefined score

measurement_plan.measure_before: Report raw selected category count distribution/zero tracts by type, region, and provided ur_class; report frozen v0 and independently recomputed v2 raw-count candidate moments and defined fractions by the same groups; verify v2 all/region means against the frozen audit report.
measurement_plan.measure_after: For thresholds 0.5, 0.7, 0.9 report weighted count deltas versus raw, POI score deltas versus v2 raw, score mean/variance/std and candidate-defined fraction by region and ur_class, source-metadata coverage, exact official IDs/order, schema/bounds, and deterministic hashes.
measurement_plan.within_region_dispersion: population variance and standard deviation of candidate POI scores for each region and urbanity group

limitations: Confidence thresholds are fixed sensitivities, not learned calibration; confidence is an Overture attribute, not validation against the organizer reference.
The v2 logistic presence prior and k_pop=0.024 are existing qualitative analysis-only assumptions; these candidates do not establish accuracy or authorize scored integration.
No unclassified category is treated as a selected core facility; the same fixed v2 region-share allocation is retained for all variants.
Source dataset membership is descriptive provenance only; it is not a truth/completeness rating or model weight.
